evidenceKind: Sanitized native Graph v1.0 create acknowledgment retained by Hypervibe, followed by independently read native application listing and exact-object GET. IDs and names are replaced in reconstructed transport tests; timestamp strings are unchanged.
documentedContract: createdDateTime is a read-only DateTimeOffset in UTC ISO 8601 format. The documentation does not promise identical fractional precision across create and read responses.
limits: This observation supports the exact same-object fractional-create/whole-second-read case. It does not authorize accepting a different second, conflicting fractional timestamp, changed identity/configuration or repeated creation.
